            continue
        script_name = os.path.basename(script_path)
        start = time.time()
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, script_path], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        end = time.time()
        results[script_name] = end - start
    return results
